after.text: Recruited into our story about ourselves. The face of another person, the steam above tea this simplicity is not dullness. It is vivid. It lets things be just what they are before they are, the ache in the chest, the sound of rain on a window: each arrives without needing permission.

To live from such simplicity is already a kind of compassion. One does not the world have to manipulate so intensely when one is things to appear not trying to secure oneself through every encounter. There is room for, and in that room something gentle becomes possible.
